title: effectuation in action: how pre-commitments drive international performance
core_idea: Investigates how effectual decision-making principles and real options reasoning—specifically pre-commitment, staging logic, and affordable loss—shape the creation of foreign market entry opportunities and relate to international performance in SMEs, with experiential learning as a moderating factor.
tldr: Examines whether and how SMEs' use of effectuation (pre-commitment, staging logic, affordable loss) and real options reasoning relates to creation of foreign market entry opportunities and international performance, considering experiential learning; empirically tested with a survey of 332 New Zealand SMEs using PLS-SEM.
